argument_markdown:
## Setup and CE line-bundle convention

Work throughout over the balanced tetragonal moduli stack B^{bal} of smooth genus-6 curves with a degree-four cover φ:C→P^1 whose scroll/Tschirnhausen bundle splits as F≅O(4)⊕O(5). Following the packet and SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6, the Casnati–Ekedahl summands are

W_f := (O_{P(E^∨)}(2) ⊗ γ^* O_{P^1}(-f))|_C,

so that W ≅ W_4 ⊕ W_5 on C. (Packet emphasis: W_5 is the f_2=5 summand of (O(2)⊗γ^*F^∨)|_C, not the O_{P^1}(5) summand of F; the sign in γ^*O(-f) is the one used in the degree computation below.)

## Source-backed degree formulas (SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6)

SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 supplies:

- deg(W_f|_C) = 4g + 12 − 4f;
- H^0(C, ω_C ⊗ W^∨(Γ)) = ⊕_i H^0(C, ω_C ⊗ W_{f_i}^∨(Γ));
- deg(ω_C ⊗ W_f^∨(Γ)) = 4f + n − 2g − 14.

Substituting g=6 gives deg(W_5)=4·6+12−20=16 and deg(W_4)=8. For L:=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1} one has deg(L)=16−(2·6−2)=6. Substituting (g,n)=(6,6) into the obstruction degree yields

- f=4: 4·4+6−12−14=−4;
- f=5: 4·5+6−12−14=0.

These are the packet degree calculations and match FND-0062, FND-0063, FND-0074 (borderline n=6 case).

## Proved step: vanishing of the f=4 summand

On any smooth geometric fibre, if deg(ω_C⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=−4<0 then H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=0 for every effective Γ of degree n=6. Thus the f=4 component of the CE obstruction never contributes on B^{bal} (FND-0062). Evaluation failure is entirely carried by the f=5 summand.

## Proved step: f=5 failure is an Abel–Jacobi condition

For the f=5 summand, deg(ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))=0. A degree-zero line bundle on a smooth curve has a nonzero global section if and only if it is trivial. Hence

H^0(C, ω_C ⊗ W_5^∨(Γ)) ≠ 0  ⇔  ω_C ⊗ W_5^∨(Γ) ≅ O_C  ⇔  O_C(Γ) ≅ W_5 ⊗ ω_C^{-1} =: L.

Combined with the direct-sum decomposition of the obstruction and the vanishing of the f=4 summand, CE evaluation fails on Γ if and only if O_C(Γ)≅L (FND-0063). This is the six-point failure condition stated in the packet bottleneck.

## Construction of Z (ordered and unordered models)

Define relative objects over B^{bal}:

1. L := W_5 ⊗ ω_{C/B^{bal}}^{-1}, a relative degree-six line bundle on the universal curve;
2. Sym^6_{C/B^{bal}}, the relative space of effective degree-six divisors;
3. U^{red} ⊂ Sym^6, the open locus of reduced support (pairwise distinct points as an unordered set);
4. Conf_6(C/B^{bal}), the stack of ordered 6-tuples of pairwise distinct sections of the universal curve;
5. Z^{bal,unord} := { Γ ∈ U^{red} | O_C(Γ) ≅ L }, the reduced-support Abel–Jacobi incidence for L;
6. Z^{bal} := Conf_6 ×_{U^{red}} Z^{bal,unord}, the ordered evaluation-failure locus.

By the geometric-point identification above, the geometric points of Z^{bal,unord} (resp. Z^{bal}) are exactly the reduced unordered (resp. ordered distinct) CE evaluation-failure configurations on balanced tetragonal fibres.

## Source-backed covering statement

FND-0064 (cf. FND-0075 for stack vs coarse caveats): the forgetful map Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) → U^{red} is a finite étale S_6-torsor on the stack of pairwise-distinct sections. Restricting to the incidence cut out by O(Γ)≅L therefore yields a finite étale S_6-torsor Z^{bal} → Z^{bal,unord} over the reduced-support open. With Q-coefficients, S_6-invariants and coinvariants agree, so rational descent from ordered to unordered is harmless; integral or coarse-space descent is not claimed here (FND-0075).

## What Riemann–Roch does and does not give

Riemann–Roch gives χ(L)=deg(L)+1−g=6+1−6=1, so on every geometric fibre the full Abel–Jacobi fibre in Sym^6 is nonempty as a scheme-theoretic fibre of the map to Pic^6 (FND-0005 nonemptiness of the full failure locus is compatible with this). By FND-0083 this does **not** prove that the reduced-support open U^{red}∩|L|, nor the ordered Conf_6 incidence Z^{bal}, is nonempty on every geometric fibre. Fibrewise nonemptiness of Z^{bal} is therefore a gap (GAP-Z-RED-NONEMPTY), not a theorem of this attempt.

## Explicit non-claims (downstream nodes and failed routes avoided)

- **Not claimed:** scheme-theoretic equality of the CE evaluation degeneracy ideal (Fitting/determinantal structure) with the relative Abel–Jacobi incidence over arbitrary bases (FND-0046 → GAP-Z-FITTING). Geometric-point equivalence is what is proved.
- **Not claimed:** that H^0(ω⊗W_f^∨(Γ)) are identified with CE obstruction spaces by a full citation-independent reconstruction of the CE evaluation map beyond SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6's degree/Serre package (FND-0061 → GAP-Z-CE-ID). The attempt takes SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 as the source-backed identification of the obstruction groups.
- **Not claimed:** closed pure-codimension-4 embedding of Z^{bal} in M_{6,6}; FND-0052 records that the balanced reduced-support relative linear system is an open piece of the failure locus (GAP-Z-OPEN). Closedness/codimension, components, dimensions, and stabilizers are C66-GEO-COMP (and related) matter (FND-0067, FND-0069, FND-0086).
- **Not claimed:** constancy of h^0(L) or identification of |L| with a relative P^2-bundle (FND-0058, FND-0047); that is C66-GEO-H0. The relation h^0(L)=1+h^0(M) for M=ω_C^2⊗W_5^∨ of degree 4 (FND-0073) is recorded as an input for H0, not used to strengthen GEO-Z.
- **Not claimed:** any Tate, purity, Gysin, or lowest-weight statement about W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6}) (FND-0050, FND-0054, FND-0055). Completing RED-0001 requires the full GEO-Z→GEO-H0→GEO-COMP→TATE-SUPPORT→TATE-ASSEMBLY chain (FND-0057).

## Blocked routes addressed (not used)

- `vcd-only-vanishing`: irrelevant to constructing Z; vcd vanishing cannot identify the CE failure locus (FND-0035).
- `undecorated-cgp-top-weight-graph-complex`: controls top weight, not the lowest-weight corner or CE geometry (FND-0032).
- `point-count-without-degree-parity-separation`: no point-counting is used; finite experiments cannot close the identification.
- `forgetful-map-renaming-local-system-unknown`: no Leray analysis of M_{6,6}→M_{6,5} or renaming of mixed R^1 systems (FND-0036, FND-0037).

No blocked route is reopened; `new_inputs` is empty.

## Status of the subproblem

C66-GEO-Z is advanced by an exact geometric-point construction and identification of the balanced evaluation-failure locus Z^{bal}/Z^{bal,unord} as the ordered/unordered reduced-support Abel–Jacobi incidence of L=W_5⊗ω^{-1}, with f=4 vanishing and the finite étale S_6 model. The four named gaps remain undischarged and are the correct interface to scheme theory (COMP/COMP-RANK), nonemptiness, and later h^0/component/Tate nodes. This attempt does **not** resolve RED-0001.

claims.statement: On B^{bal} with g=6, deg(W_5)=16 and deg(L)=deg(W_5⊗ω_C^{-1})=6, using deg(W_f)=4g+12−4f and the packet sign convention γ^*O(−f).
For (g,n)=(6,6) and any effective Γ of degree 6 on a balanced fibre, deg(ω_C⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=−4, hence H^0(ω_C⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=0; the f=4 CE obstruction summand vanishes identically.
For (g,n)=(6,6) and any effective Γ of degree 6 on a balanced fibre, deg(ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))=0, and H^0(ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))≠0 if and only if O_C(Γ)≅L=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}.

χ(L)=1 on every geometric fibre, so the full Abel–Jacobi fibre of L in Sym^6 is nonempty; this does not imply nonemptiness of U^{red}∩|L| or of Z^{bal} on every fibre.

novelty_claims: Weakest-sufficient geometric-point construction of the balanced CE evaluation-failure locus for (6,6) as the ordered/unordered reduced-support Abel–Jacobi incidence of L=W_5⊗ω^{-1}, with f=4 vanishing isolated and scheme/closedness/nonemptiness claims deferred as named gaps rather than overclaimed.
summary: On the balanced tetragonal stack for (6,6), the CE evaluation obstruction splits as f=4⊕f=5; the f=4 summand vanishes identically (degree −4) and the f=5 summand has degree 0, so failure is exactly the Abel–Jacobi condition O_C(Γ)≅W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}. The ordered locus is the finite étale S_6-pullback of the reduced-support open in that incidence. Scheme structure, reduced-support nonemptiness on every fibre, closedness/codimension in M_{6,6}, and all Tate claims remain gaps for later nodes.
theorem_statement: Let g=n=6 and let B^{bal} be the moduli stack of smooth genus-6 curves equipped with a balanced tetragonal structure C→P^1 with Tschirnhausen/scroll splitting F≅O_{P^1}(4)⊕O_{P^1}(5). Write W_f:=(O_{P(E^∨)}(2)⊗γ^*O_{P^1}(-f))|_C for the Casnati–Ekedahl summands (packet convention: W_5 is the f_2=5 summand of (O(2)⊗γ^*F^∨)|_C, not the O(5) summand of F), and set L:=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}. Let Sym^6_{C/B^{bal}} be the relative effective degree-six divisor space, U^{red}⊂Sym^6 its open locus of reduced support, and Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) the stack of ordered pairwise-distinct sections. Define the unordered evaluation-failure incidence Z^{bal,unord} as the locus of reduced effective Γ of degree 6 with O_C(Γ)≅L, and the ordered model Z^{bal} as its pullback along Conf_6→U^{red}. Then, on every geometric fibre of B^{bal}: (i) deg(W_5)=16 and deg(L)=6; (ii) for any effective Γ of degree 6, H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=0 (obstruction degree −4), while deg(ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))=0 and H^0(C,ω_C⊗W_5^∨(Γ))≠0 if and only if O_C(Γ)≅L; (iii) consequently CE evaluation fails on a reduced degree-six divisor Γ (resp. ordered 6-tuple of distinct points) if and only if O_C(Γ)≅L (resp. the underlying unordered divisor lies in Z^{bal,unord}); (iv) Conf_6→U^{red} is a finite étale S_6-torsor, so Z^{bal}→Z^{bal,unord} is likewise a finite étale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open. This constructs and identifies the balanced evaluation-failure locus at the level of geometric points and ordered/unordered reduced-support models; it does not assert scheme-theoretic Fitting equality with a CE degeneracy ideal, fibrewise nonemptiness of U^{red}∩|L|, closed pure-codimension embedding in M_{6,6}, h^0-stratification, components/stabilizers, or Tate type.
